title: Director of Business Development

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: The Director of Business Development owns strategic partnerships, channel development, and new market opportunities for Ricoh's graphics and signage portfolio. This role is tasked with identifying adjacent revenue streams and ecosystem partnerships that enhance Ricoh's market position without requiring heavy R&D investment. A partnership with DuPont Tedlar represents a high-value, low-risk opportunity: co-marketing at trade shows like PRINTING United, creating joint customer success stories, developing certification programs that position Ricoh+Tedlar as the premium solution for outdoor durability, and potentially establishing referral revenue streams. Their KPIs include partnership revenue, new market penetration, and strategic relationship value. Given Ricoh already provides Sign & Graphics Professional Services including training programs, integrating Tedlar education and recommendations into their service offerings creates immediate value. This role would see Tedlar as a strategic asset that strengthens customer relationships, opens doors to architectural and transit markets where extreme durability matters, and differentiates Ricoh's commercial printing ecosystem from competitors who only sell equipment.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: [Name] owns strategic partnerships and channel development for Ricoh's wide-format printing business, focusing on creating ecosystem value beyond equipment sales. They likely report to a VP of Sales or Chief Revenue Officer and collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, and professional services teams. Their authority includes identifying partnership opportunities, negotiating co-marketing agreements, and developing joint go-to-market strategies. They evaluate partners based on customer value creation, revenue potential, and competitive differentiation—making them the gatekeeper for ecosystem relationships that enhance Ricoh's $3.7B business without requiring heavy capital investment.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Ricoh's Pro L5160e and Pro TF6251 printers produce vehicle wraps, exhibition graphics, outdoor signage, and backlit displays—applications where Tedlar's UV protection and graffiti resistance directly extend the lifespan of Ricoh customers' printed output. [Name] would care about three specific use cases: (1) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics where Ricoh's PSP customers face warranty claims from premature fading—Tedlar's 12-20+ year outdoor durability transforms this pain point into a competitive advantage; (2) Outdoor signage and exhibition graphics for Ricoh's Fortune 500 clients who demand premium solutions—Tedlar enables Ricoh to position their equipment as part of a total cost of ownership story rather than just print quality; (3) Architectural graphics and building wraps where Ricoh could expand into higher-margin markets by offering customers a complete solution that includes proven protective film recommendations. Since Ricoh already provides Sign & Graphics Professional Services with training programs, integrating Tedlar education creates immediate customer value.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name]'s KPIs likely include partnership revenue contribution, new market penetration rates, and strategic relationship ROI. They personally care about partnerships that: (1) Create stickiness with Ricoh's 1.4M business customers by solving post-sale problems like print durability and maintenance costs; (2) Differentiate Ricoh from HP, Canon, and Epson in competitive equipment deals by offering ecosystem value competitors can't match; (3) Generate measurable revenue through co-marketing programs, referral fees, or certification training without requiring Ricoh to manufacture new products. Tedlar solves a critical pain point: when Ricoh sells a $100K+ printer but customers experience UV degradation or graffiti vandalism on their output, it creates dissatisfaction that [Name]'s partnerships should prevent. By positioning Ricoh+Tedlar as the proven solution for outdoor durability, [Name] strengthens customer retention, opens doors to architectural and transit markets, and creates partnership revenue streams that enhance their business development metrics.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Ricoh showcased at PRINTING United Expo 2025 in Orlando (October 22-24) and has consistent presence at this key industry event, making Q1-Q2 2026 ideal timing for partnership discussions before PRINTING United 2026 planning begins. Their recent focus on outdoor durability with the Pro L5160e latex printer indicates active product positioning around this customer need. Additionally, Ricoh serves 85% of Fortune 500 companies who increasingly demand sustainability and total cost of ownership solutions—Tedlar's reduced replacement frequency and maintenance costs align with enterprise procurement trends. The fact that Ricoh already offers professional services training programs creates immediate integration opportunity without requiring lengthy product development cycles.

personalization_hooks.hook: Ricoh's Pro L5160e and Pro TF6251 printers target vehicle wraps and outdoor exhibition graphics where customers face UV degradation and graffiti vandalism
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar partnership as solving the post-sale durability problem that affects Ricoh customers' ROI—frame this as a competitive differentiator when selling against HP and Canon who only focus on print quality specs

personalization_hooks.hook: Ricoh already provides Sign & Graphics Professional Services including hands-on training programs for finishing and signage applications
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Propose integrating Tedlar education into existing training programs as a quick-win partnership that immediately adds customer value without requiring new infrastructure—this is a natural extension of services Ricoh already delivers

personalization_hooks.hook: Ricoh exhibited at PRINTING United Expo 2025 and serves 85% of Fortune 500 companies who demand premium, proven solutions
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their trade show presence and Fortune 500 customer base to frame Tedlar as the proven protective film that reinforces Ricoh's premium positioning—suggest co-exhibiting or joint customer success stories for PRINTING United 2026

recommended_approach: Lead with partnership opportunity angle rather than product pitch—frame Tedlar as a strategic asset that enhances Ricoh's customer success and competitive positioning. Focus on low-risk, high-value integration points like co-marketing at trade shows and adding Tedlar to existing professional services training. Emphasize how this partnership solves customer pain points that affect Ricoh's equipment sales and retention without requiring Ricoh to invest in manufacturing or R&D.
